clips.label: The Cartographer’s Dream · 1 minute
clips.note: Follow a blue ink river from an ivory atlas through waterfalls, amethyst caverns and enormous paper folds into a branching delta.
clips.details:
A new story directed around faster floating camera movement. Close banks and mineral formations pass the camera, the river opens a route through a giant paper arch, and a travelling pullback reveals the blue ink network. The blue route, pale sculptural landforms and warm light connect the changing worlds. Small incidental figures appear briefly around the waterfall; individual details continue to redraw.

Silent 60-second cut, 1536×1024, 24 fps. All 540 selected paintings are retained. Delivery runs at 4.5× the source clock, equivalent to 3× the original Storm Engine delivery clock, with varied camera paths and acceleration. RIFE fills the two- and three-frame painting intervals outside recurrence. Two additional frames hold the last painting (0.083 seconds).
